req.title: Retrieve player by ID
req.statement: The system shall respond to GET /players/{playerId} with the corresponding player object.

doc.reasoning: The test suite is designed to validate the functionality of retrieving a player by ID through the FastAPI endpoint. It includes a positive test to ensure correct retrieval, a negative test to handle non-existent IDs, and a boundary test to check the behavior with a valid UUID format but non-existent ID.

tests.name: test_retrieve_player_by_valid_id
preconditions: Player with ID '97da2849-d73e-4b43-8a90-7d090402c802' exists in the database.
expected: Response contains player data with ID '97da2849-d73e-4b43-8a90-7d090402c802'.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)
response = client.get('/players/97da2849-d73e-4b43-8a90-7d090402c802')
assert response.status_code == 200
assert response.json()['id'] == '97da2849-d73e-4b43-8a90-7d090402c802'
assert response.json()['firstName'] == 'Anjali'

tests.name: test_retrieve_player_by_nonexistent_id
preconditions: No player with ID '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' exists in the database.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)
response = client.get('/players/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
assert response.status_code == 404

tests.name: test_retrieve_player_by_boundary_id
preconditions: No player with ID 'ffffffff-ffff-ffff-ffff-ffffffffffff' exists in the database.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)
response = client.get('/players/ffffffff-ffff-ffff-ffff-ffffffffffff')
assert response.status_code == 404
